useCase.name: Show who has not paid and how much is outstanding

intent.name: fee.overdue.list
intent.summary: Show who has not paid and how much, aged from the due date, for a class, a section, one student or the whole school. One step, and it contacts nobody.
routesHere: show me the overdue list for Grade 4

routesHere.gloss: who has not paid the fees?
how much does this family owe?

routesHere.gloss: how much is outstanding for more than three months?

routesHere: what's the total outstanding across the school

request.text: in sab ko reminder bhej do

routesElsewhere.note: Running the list creates nothing, changes nothing and sends nothing. Contacting a family is a separate, deliberate act (BR-10).

request.gloss: how much will the bill come to?

routesElsewhere.note: A preview is what would be billed; this is what was billed and not paid.

request.text: in ka installment plan bana do
request.gloss: set up an installment plan for them

routesElsewhere.note: A student meeting an approved plan is not overdue while the plan is being met (BR-2).

steps.note: One step. Every figure is calculated as billed less paid at the moment the list is run (BR-4, BR-5) — the plan supplies no amount and no age.

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. An empty result is an answer, not a failure (E1). Row scope is enforced by the API and arrives as an error.
plan.atomicity: A read. Nothing is created, changed or sent (BR-10). The figures reflect every payment recorded up to the moment it runs, so a family who paid this morning is not on the afternoon list (BR-5).

operations.name: fee.overdue.list
operations.purpose: Return unpaid invoices past their due date for a scope, with each debt's age, its remaining balance and the total.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.notes: What the list covers. Staff may run a single student's position at the counter but not the school-wide list — who owes what across the school is a management figure (BR-9, E4).

parameters.name: class_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No active class of that name.

parameters.notes: Required where the scope is Class.

parameters.name: section_id
parameters.notes: Required where the scope is Section.

parameters.name: student_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No student matches in scope.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with class and section.

parameters.notes: Required where the scope is Student.

parameters.name: age_band
parameters.type: enum: 1 to 30 days | 31 to 60 days | 61 to 90 days | Over 90 days
parameters.notes: Only where the request narrows by age. The age of a debt decides how hard it is to recover and what the school does about it (BR-3).

parameters.name: minimum_amount
parameters.notes: Hides debts below a threshold. Only where the request states one — a threshold invented here hides real debt.

parameters.name: include_students_on_a_plan
parameters.notes: Off by default. A plan being met is not overdue; only a missed installment brings a family onto the list (BR-2, BR-4 of this use case). Never set true to make a list longer.

parameters.name: academic_session_id
parameters.notes: Only where the request names a past session. Debts outlive the session that created them and recovery work continues (BR-7). Omitted, it defaults to the open one.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: Who owes what, and for how long.

fields.name: rows
fields.description: student, class, section, invoice_number, billed, paid, amount_outstanding, days_overdue, age_band.

fields.name: total_outstanding
fields.description: The sum for the scope — the figure the school's position is read from.

fields.name: excluded_on_plan
fields.description: Families meeting an approved plan, kept off the list (BR-2).

fields.name: run_at
fields.description: When it was run. A list run during an invoice batch is stamped so the two are not confused (E5).

fields.name: scope_note
fields.description: What the list covers, in words. Reported with the total.

errors.meaning: No invoice in the scope is overdue.
errors.note: Message: "No overdue fees for this class and period." An answer, not a failure — and a good one.

errors.meaning: No academic session is open and none was named.
The list exceeds the display threshold.
errors.note: Narrow by class, age band or minimum amount. Narrowing is the actor's choice, not the planner's.

errors.meaning: A Staff user attempted the school-wide list.
errors.note: Staff see one student's position at the counter (BR-9). In practice the scope is constrained by the allow-list.

errors.meaning: The list was run while an invoice batch was being issued.
errors.note: The result is stamped with the time and the batch. Report both — the figure is a moment, not a fact.

planningRules.rule: Never supply an amount or an age. Both are calculated as billed less paid and due date to today (BR-3, BR-4); a figure held anywhere else drifts from the ledger, which is exactly what BR-4 forbids.
Never set include_students_on_a_plan to widen a list. A family paying as agreed must not be chased (BR-2), and a longer list is not a better one.
Never chain a reminder onto the list. Running it sends nothing (BR-10), and who gets chased is a decision somebody takes after reading it.
Report the run time with the total, and say so where the list ran during an invoice batch. The figure is a position at a moment, and BR-5 means it moves as payments come in.
Never treat an empty list as a failure. No overdue fees is the answer the school wants (E1).

Report a partially paid invoice at its remaining balance, never its billed amount. BR-6 is the difference between chasing a family for what they still owe and chasing them for what they have already partly paid.
branch_id and session_id come from $session unless the request names a past session for recovery work (BR-7).

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to reverse.

steps.note: No amount, no age band and no plan flag are supplied — the defaults are the safe ones (PR-2).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Nine families with a total of PKR 41,500, each with days overdue and an age band. Two families meeting an installment plan are excluded and counted separately (BR-2). Report the run time with the total.

resolvedPlans.outcome: One row with the outstanding balance and how long it has been due. Where the invoice is partly paid, the remaining balance is what is reported — not the billed amount (PR-6).
